findings.evidence: Mathlib/Data/Finset/Image.lean:429 provides `Finset.image_injective`; Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:1109 provides `Function.Injective.image_injective`, while Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean:131 defines `map` as exactly the corresponding set image.
findings.fix: Unfold `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map` and compose `Finset.image_injective hf` with `Function.Injective.image_injective`, using extensionality only to pass between complexes and their face sets.
findings.issue: `map_injective` manually reconstructs injectivity of the nested set/finset image defining `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Logic/Relation.lean:713 defines `ReflTransGen.lift`; `CollapsesTo` is `Relation.ReflTransGen ElementaryCollapsesTo` at Collapse/Basic.lean:93, so this theorem directly replaces lines 195–199.
findings.fix: Use `Relation.ReflTransGen.lift (fun P => P.map f)` with the already-proved `ElementaryCollapsesTo.map` as the edge-preservation argument.
findings.issue: `CollapsesTo.map` performs a custom reflexive-transitive-closure induction through `property_of_elementaryCollapsesTo`.

summary: Two proofs rederive generic Mathlib transport/injectivity combinators instead of using them directly.
